terminology.三维: 用户定义的一层晶包；本程序不定义具体层划分

provenance_refinement: for each old sign word: 6^n axis words; projected count times 6^n, dominant divided by 6^n, total unchanged
transverse_scope: component-square linear algebra, not a crystal layer or new native perpendicularity

cases.axis_routing: iid uniform on six axes, independent of entire sign process
cases.exact_scalar_observer: sum of all six raw coordinates
cases.finite_sign_result_scope: verified n=1..128 for this rho; not a universal finite-n theorem
